description.value: Arts Pacific Gallery is a community collective of Bowen Island artists, operating since 1998 in Artisan Square and showcasing original paintings, sculpture, ceramics, handknits, fibre arts, and jewellery by over a dozen local artists. Described on its own website as a 'small-town art gallery well worth the visit,' it has been a favourite destination for tourists exploring Bowen Island's creative community for nearly three decades.
